user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Update task description with valid input
steps: Navigate to the task management page
Click on 'Edit' button of the selected task
positive.expected_result: Task description is updated and saved successfully

negative.title: Update task description with SQL injection text
steps: Navigate to the task management page
Click on 'Edit' button of the selected task
Enter an SQL injection string as the description
negative.expected_result: Error message shown and changes are not saved

edge.title: Update task description with extremely long text
steps: Navigate to the task management page
Click on 'Edit' button of the selected task
Enter a very long description exceeding the character limit
edge.expected_result: Validation error shown: description exceeds maximum allowed length
